scope: Feature terminology verified against public Adobe InDesign help, with related labels made consistent. This is not a complete official UI string catalog. Unverified or ambiguous entries and DesignCraft-specific messages retain their existing translations.
arabic_scope: Adobe documents English or French interfaces for its Arabic-capable editions. Arabic entries here follow Arabic help terminology, not an official Arabic application interface.
review_method: English/localized control-name alignment was used only to find candidates. Changes were selected by meaning; differing document order, conflicting alternatives, prose accidentally styled as controls and unrelated matches were rejected. Existing wording was retained when already documented. Related-label entries adopt verified terms but do not claim their whole label is an exact Adobe UI string.
